settings.title: Teams with many customers, many products and margins that matter.

settings.editor: If your buyers are known and your sales team is busy, there is usually more revenue to find in the data you already have.

settings.title: Six kinds of businesses I know well.

settings.editor: Plants and OEMs with big product catalogues, dealer networks and price lists that change often.
Cement, steel, tiles and fittings sold through distributors, where small price slips add up fast.
Brands with thousands of outlets, where the next order and the right scheme decide the month.
Teams juggling many SKUs and customers, who need to know who to call and what to offer.
Fast-growing companies whose CRM, billing and support data sit in different tools.
Owner-led companies that want enterprise-grade sales tools without an enterprise project.
